name: myTickrs
description: myTickrs tracks your investment portfolio: lots, cost basis, profit and loss, and returns, with market data from built-in and plugin providers. Your data stays in a SQLite database in appdata, and can optionally sync with the myTickrs cloud. Security: the self-hosted edition has no sign-in. Anyone who can reach the port can use the app, so do not expose it outside your network. If you change the WebUI port, set PORT to the same number.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: SQLite database and the key that encrypts stored provider keys. Back up the whole folder; keep the key with the database.

paths.name: Data-provider plugins
paths.description: Optional. Folder for extra data-provider plugins. Leave empty to use the plugins built into the image; a folder here replaces them.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for the web interface. Keep it equal to PORT.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Port the app listens on inside the container. Must equal the WebUI port.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User the app runs as and that owns App Data. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group the app runs as. 100 is Unraid's users.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace or silent.

variables.name: KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.description: Optional. Base64 of 32 bytes that encrypts stored provider keys. If empty, one is generated and saved in App Data.
